newsitem.title: USA: Equinox sees 4th-qtr net below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Equinox sees 4th-qtr net below expectations.

text.p: Equinox Systems Inc said Wednesday its fourth-quarter and full-year earnings for 1996 will be less than analysts' expectations because of the timing of OEM orders.
The company, which said its earnings for 1996 would be about $2.6 million, did not give more specific details about the quarter. Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
The company said its fourth-quarter sales for 1996 will roughly equal those from the fourth quarter of 1995. That means annual sales of about $25 million, the company said.
